subject: [PATCH 3/8] nfsd: move the control plane to a per-namespace mutex

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the control plane of the NFS daemon (nfsd) to a per-namespace mutex, reducing serialization across network namespaces and improving performance. The global nfsd_mutex is retained for host-wide resources, while the new nn->nfsd_mutex handles namespace-specific data. This change allows for concurrent startup and shutdown of NFS services in different namespaces, reducing stalls and improving scalability.
